title: Fix path traversal in FileMemoryStore.SanitizeId
description:
P0 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P0-001). FileMemoryStore.SanitizeId() regex `[/\\:?*]` does not filter parent-directory `..` sequences. A memory record with Id containing `..` would resolve outside the base path via Path.Combine. Add `..` to the regex or validate resolved path via Path.GetFullPath against the base path.

File: MemorySmith.Storage/FileMemoryStore.cs (line ~76)
Confidence: 95%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
